Per-fit deadline90seconds is administrative; historic controls used60seconds and unchanged-arm numeric parity must hold.
No global convergence, native family qualification, Lake admission, Constitution formalization, or checkpoint promotion is established.
Historical8D linguistic teacher unchanged; no verified local768D experiment.
